title: CF-JEPA: Improving Robustness of JEPA World Models via Controllability Factorization
abstract: arXiv:2610.00727v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Controlling an agent with vision requires being able to separate useful information from irrelevant background information. JEPA-style latent world models seem like a natural approach for this, as they do not perform pixel-level reconstruction; however, they are still sensitive to these distractor signals and experience latent collapse. In this work, we introduce Controllability Factorized JEPA (CF-JEPA), a JEPA-style world model which splits the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces. This factorization allows us to capture all the distractor information into the uncontrollable region, while we use the control-relevant latent information for our task. With this, we show comparable performance across 2D and 3D control tasks under nominal conditions and improved performance under distracted conditions, where CF-JEPA is the only model that does not experience latent collapse. We also validate our model under distract

translated_title: CF-JEPA：通过可控性分解提升JEPA世界模型的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 基于视觉对智能体进行控制，需要能够将有用信息与无关的背景信息分离开来。JEPA式的潜在世界模型似乎是实现这一目标的自然方法，因为它们不执行像素级重建；然而，这类模型仍然对这些干扰信号敏感，并会出现潜在坍塌现象。在本工作中，我们提出了可控性分解JEPA（CF-JEPA），这是一种将潜在空间划分为可控与不可控子空间的JEPA式世界模型。这种分解使我们能够将所有干扰信息捕获到不可控区域中，而在执行任务时仅使用与控制相关的潜在信息。借此，我们展示了在正常条件下，该模型在2D和3D控制任务上取得了相当的性能，而在有干扰的条件下则表现出更优的性能——其中CF-JEPA是唯一没有出现潜在坍塌的模型。我们还在有干扰条件下验证了我们的模型。
tldr: CF-JEPA通过将潜在空间分解为可控与不可控子空间，把干扰信息隔离到不可控区域，从而显著提升了JEPA世界模型在干扰环境下的鲁棒性，是唯一避免潜在坍塌的模型。
en_tdlr: CF-JEPA improves the robustness of JEPA world models by factoring the latent space into controllable and uncontrollable subspaces, isolating distractor information, and it is the only model that avoids latent collapse under distracted conditions.
